title: blocker_a3ba1690 also gates load: k6 has no target on this machine, and the baseline fails red instead of skipping
body:
VERIFIED by running, 2026-08-23, from the load session:
  - Nothing listens on localhost:3000 (curl: connection refused).
  - ../wayfarer beside the hub checkout has .env.example but no .env.local, so it
    cannot be built here for the same reason ui gave in blocker_a3ba1690.
  - BASE_URL is unset in this session; no deployed target has been published.
  - k6 run -u 1 --duration 3s tests/load/baseline.js -> every request logs
    'dial tcp 127.0.0.1:3000: connect: connection refused'; http_req_failed
    trips its rate<0.01 threshold and the run exits non-zero.

WHY THIS IS WORTH A SEPARATE LINE: the lane skill says specs skip while
BASE_URL is unset. That is true of the Playwright lanes, not of k6. baseline.js
defaults BASE_URL to localhost:3000 and runs regardless, so a machine with no
app produces a RED run that is indistinguishable at a glance from a real
performance regression. Not raising a second blocker -- ui's covers it and
either of its two clearances (owner supplies .env.local, or a BASE_URL is
published) unblocks load identically. This entry is so the queue shows one
blocker gating two lanes, not one.

NOT DONE: I have not changed baseline.js. Proposed follow-up in my lane:
abort in setup() with a clear message when BASE_URL is unset, so 'no target'
reads as skipped rather than failed. Will do on hub's say-so.

title: k6 framework landed at 338797b: no-target runs skip with exit 0; smoke verified green against the deployment, 20/20 requests, p95 55ms
body:
DELIVERED at 338797b (framework) and 008bc73 (hook mode fix), both on lane/load.

STRUCTURE (all under tests/load/)
  lib/config.js   target resolution (BASE_URL only -- NO localhost default any
                  more), route tags (static|results), shared thresholds, and
                  the shared journeys visitStaticRoutes / visitResults.
  smoke.js        1 VU, 10s, prerendered routes ONLY (/ and /plan). A pulse
                  check, deliberately excluding server-rendered /results so it
                  stays harmless against a shared public target while the data
                  backend is down (blocker_a3ba1690). Lax duration budget:
                  smoke fails on failed requests, not slow ones.
  baseline.js     unchanged shape (30s ramp to 10 VUs, 1m hold, 30s down; all
                  routes; same budgets as before) refactored onto lib/config.js.
  stress.js       defined (ramp to 50 VUs, ~6 min) but GUARDED: refuses any
                  *.vercel.app host outright, and any other non-loopback host
                  unless STRESS_ALLOW_REMOTE=i-own-this-target is passed.
                  Local or dedicated targets only; no npm script on purpose.
  preflight.mjs   the approved skip mechanism. Node script: BASE_URL unset ->
                  SKIPPED, exit 0. Set -> GET <target>/ with a 10s timeout;
                  any HTTP status counts as alive (a target answering 500
                  should be measured red, not skipped); network-level failure
                  -> SKIPPED, exit 0. Alive -> exec k6 with the exit code
                  passed through, so threshold breaches still fail. k6 missing
                  while a target IS reachable exits 1: environment defect, not
                  a skip.

SCRIPTS: test:load = baseline via preflight; test:load:smoke added. Direct
k6 run without BASE_URL aborts in init with instructions (non-zero; the npm
scripts are the skip-safe path).

SKIP DEMO, verified by running, exit code echoed:
  npm run test:load        (BASE_URL unset)
  load tests SKIPPED -- no target: BASE_URL is not set
  SKIPPED is not a pass: 0 requests were sent, nothing was measured.
  To run: point BASE_URL at a reachable deployment, e.g. BASE_URL=<url> npm run test:load
  exit=0
Unreachable branch also verified: BASE_URL at a closed local port -> "target
... did not answer the preflight probe (ECONNREFUSED)", exit 0.

SMOKE VERIFIED against https://wayfarer-xi.vercel.app, 2026-08-24, by running
npm run test:load:smoke from the load session: exit 0, 11.5s wall, 10
iterations, 20 requests (10x GET /, 10x GET /plan) plus 1 preflight probe of
/. http_req_failed 0.00% (0 of 20); checks 20/20; http_req_duration avg
41.7ms, med 40.1ms, p95 54.9ms, max 55.8ms. All three thresholds passed.
/results was NOT touched, per task_b9db4231 and blocker_a3ba1690.

NOT DONE
  - baseline and stress have never executed under this refactor: no target can
    take them today (the deployment's /results 500s, and heavier profiles must
    not point at the public deployment regardless). Both parse clean under k6
    inspect, and the stress guards were verified to throw on *.vercel.app and
    on non-loopback hosts without the ack. The first real baseline run still
    owes the board a numbers entry.
  - baseline thresholds are carried over from the old file, not re-derived.
  - no stress npm script, by design; documented in stress.js.

title: pre-commit disclosure hook never ran in any worktree: committed non-executable (mode 100644); fixed at 008bc73 on lane/load
body:
VERIFIED by committing from the load worktree, 2026-08-24: git printed
"hint: The '.githooks/pre-commit' hook was ignored because it's not set as
executable" and ran no scan. git ls-files -s .githooks/pre-commit showed mode
100644 -- the executable bit was never committed (hook landed in 8ea68ef) --
so every commit in every lane worktree has silently bypassed the disclosure
gate since. core.hooksPath was set correctly; the mode bit was the whole
problem.

FIX: chmod +x committed as 008bc73 on lane/load (mode-only change). That
commit is its own proof: the hook fired and printed "disclosure scan: clean
(1 staged files)". Mode bits travel with the tree, so merging propagates the
fix to every checkout.

UNTIL MERGED: other lanes' commits are NOT scanned at commit time. The
full-tree scan (node bin/scan-secrets.mjs, also in test:board) still covers
tracked content after the fact. My framework commit 338797b went in through
this gap; I re-ran the full-tree scan afterwards: clean, 31 tracked files.

ACTION for hub: merge lane/load (or cherry-pick 008bc73) to main, then have
lanes merge main. Until their worktrees carry the fix, treat lane commits as
unscanned and rely on the full-tree scan.

title: npm run test:load and test:load:smoke exit 0 with a SKIPPED message when no target answers; non-zero always means measured failure
body:
GUARANTEE as of 338797b on lane/load. With BASE_URL unset, or set but not
answering a 10-second probe of its root at the network level, both scripts
print "load tests SKIPPED -- <reason>" plus "SKIPPED is not a pass: 0
requests were sent, nothing was measured." and exit 0 without invoking k6.
When the target answers -- any HTTP status, including 500 -- k6 runs and its
exit code is passed through. So a non-zero exit from these scripts always
means a measured failure (threshold breach or script error), never a missing
environment; CI can run them unconditionally.

Scope of each script:
  test:load          baseline profile: 10 VUs for 2 minutes across / , /plan
                     and /results. Needs the data backend up.
  test:load:smoke    1 VU for 10 seconds, prerendered routes only (/ and
                     /plan) -- safe to point at a shared public deployment.

Not covered by the guarantee: direct k6 invocation (aborts non-zero when
BASE_URL is unset, by design), and the stress profile, which refuses
*.vercel.app and non-loopback hosts without an explicit acknowledgement and
has no npm script.
